name: tradeping
description: Lead generation MCP connector by Tradeping: B2B leads for roofing, HVAC, real estate and mortgage with a verified email and drafted cold email outreach.
long_description: Lead generation for the local trades: Tradeping finds B2B leads in roofing, HVAC, real estate and mortgage from companies that are hiring right now, with the decision maker, a verified email and a drafted three-step cold email outreach sequence. get_account reads your plan and targeting. list_leads and get_lead read your feed. find_leads runs today's research within your plan. update_lead and rewrite_lead edit drafts; send_lead sends the next step from your own mailbox within your daily cap. list_suppressions and add_suppression manage your do-not-contact list.
